configuration.query: Show contacts (name, title) for Adventure Works
configuration.rephrase: The query will join the contact and account table, and return all the contact name and jobtitle who are the primary contact of accounts named 'Adventure Work'
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [Contact].[fullname], [Contact].[jobtitle] FROM [Contact] JOIN [Account] ON [Contact].[contactId] = [Account].[primaryContactId] WHERE ([Account].[name] = 'Adventure Works')
